# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 11/20–11/22，更新于 2026-11-20）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 22 个活动，华美协进社:书法、音乐和中文聚会、MOCA 华埠历史徒步导览、MOCACREATE:「用心写作」亲子创作工作坊
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 12 个活动，罗格斯天文台公众观星、Turtle Back 动物园节日灯光(开幕)、Diggerland 开车看灯 Holidig
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 10 个活动，太平洋水族馆亚洲秋日节(周六/日)、Teddy Swims 演唱会、Jackson Browne 演唱会
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 9 个活动，圣何塞 Calabazas 图书馆:茶时光、圣何塞华裔历史博物馆开放日(免费)、Millbrae 图书馆国语/粤语故事会
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 10 个活动，贝尔维尤图书馆中文读书会、KATSEYE 演唱会、西雅图国际舞踏节
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 10 个活动，华人文化中心太极课、华人文化中心:小书虫故事会、华人文化中心:中英双语节奏时光(幼儿)
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 8 个活动，芝加哥公共图书馆华语电影放映《机器之血》、菲律宾圣诞市集 Paskong Pinoy、芝加哥当代艺术馆(伊州居民周二免费)
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 9 个活动，亚洲协会德州中心:天野喜孝《Big Bang》导览、Yuhan Su 三重奏《OVER the MOONs》、音乐剧《乐满哈瓦那》巡演
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 11 个活动，达拉斯交响乐团公园免费室内乐、Art After Dark 艺术夜、达拉斯市中心溜冰场开幕+点灯
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 10 个活动，嘻哈版《胡桃夹子》、乔治城 Washington Harbour 溜冰场开张、国家剧院周六早晨儿童演出(免费)
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 6 个活动，Muzeo 迪士尼档案展、Mission Viejo 节日手作集市(第 55 届)、Mission Viejo 秋日夜市(免费)
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 8 个活动，圣地亚哥环境电影节开幕夜(免费)、科罗纳多酒店海边溜冰场开幕、Liberty Station 狗狗街头节
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 7 个活动，Kamasi Washington 爵士、Lawrenceville 德式圣诞市集(开幕)、Hapeville 图书馆「感恩树」手工
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 11 个活动，多伦多华人文化中心长者活动中心(周一至周五)、Harbourfront Centre 免费展览、Jorja Smith 演唱会
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 9 个活动，中山公园:Steeped in Sound 茶与音乐、华裔加拿大人博物馆:亲子漫画活动、列治文图书馆中文幼儿时光

## City pages (English)
- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 22 events, e.g. Harlem Holiday Lights Parade; Dansaekhwa: Korean Abstract Art Lecture; 70 After Dark: Festival of Light at Asia Society
- [New Jersey weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nj/): 12 events, e.g. Rutgers Public Telescope Night; Turtle Back Zoo Holiday Lights; Holidig Drive-Thru Light Show at Diggerland
- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 10 events, e.g. Teddy Swims; Jackson Browne; Holiday in the Park, Burbank
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 9 events, e.g. Nutcracker Sweets for Little Ones; Embarcadero Center Holiday Market & Lighting; Prateek Kuhad
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 10 events, e.g. KATSEYE; Seattle International Butoh Festival; Julefest at the National Nordic Museum
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 10 events, e.g. Tai Chi Class at Chinese Culture Connection; Winter Skate Grand Opening at Patriot Place; Tai Chi & Qigong at BPL Adams Street
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 8 events, e.g. MCA Chicago Free Tuesday for Illinois Residents; Little Big Town; 113th Chicago Christmas Tree Lighting
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 9 events, e.g. Buena Vista Social Club (touring musical); ArtCrawl Houston; Islamic Arts Festival
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 11 events, e.g. DSO Chamber Concert at McIntyre Park; Art After Dark; City Rink Opening & Tree Lighting, Main Street Garden
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 10 events, e.g. The Hip-Hop Nutcracker; Washington Harbour Ice Rink Opens; Saturday Morning LIVE at the National Theatre
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 6 events, e.g. Disney Archives Exhibit at Muzeo; Gifts & Goodies Holiday Boutique; Campfire Village Fall Festival Night Market
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 8 events, e.g. San Diego Environmental Film Festival Opening Night; Skating by the Sea Opens at Hotel del Coronado; Doggie Street Festival
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 7 events, e.g. Kamasi Washington: The Prophet & The Madman; Atlanta Christkindl Market in Lawrenceville; Our Thankfulness Tree at Hapeville Library
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 11 events, e.g. Free Exhibitions at Harbourfront Centre; Jorja Smith; Shaw Festival's A Christmas Carol at Harbourfront Centre
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 9 events, e.g. Eastside Culture Crawl; Family Stay and Play; LEGO® Block Party

## Data
- [events.json](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/events.json): all events with dates, times, venues, prices and official links
- [seasonal.json](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/seasonal.json): long-running seasonal attractions (lights, markets, rinks, shows) with date ranges and hours
